Hi Alicia / Paul —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. To keep momentum, I wanted to capture the immediate integration items we discussed and propose owners/timeline so we can lock the PoC schedule: 

1) SAML metadata exchange + cert rotation cadence — Acme to provide IdP metadata, Redwood to provide SP metadata (we've attached the initial SP metadata).
2) SCIM mapping matrix — we need confirmation of attribute names for: email, displayName, department, role (and whether Acme will push modified role attributes or Redwood should infer). There’s an attached provisioning matrix to edit.
3) IAM role mapping in the Private Control Plane — our on-prem control plane supports two logical roles for customer admins: ControlPlaneAdmin and ReadOnlyAuditor. Dev, can you add the proposed IAM JSON in a follow-up?
4) Network reachability checklist — please confirm whether the connector will be outbound-only from your VPC or if a peered/private link is required. I attached a network diagram for reference.

Proposed timeline: exchange metadata and SCIM matrix by Thu 2028-03-23; dev integration and test the week of 2028-03-27; compliance audit snapshot the week after.

Next step: can we do a short technical call Thursday 11:00am PT to walk through SCIM attribute mappings? If that works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite with a brief agenda.

Thanks —

Dylan / team —

Putting together the technical notes from our side. High-level answers below and a proposed ControlPlane role mapping.

1) SAML/SP behavior: we support dual certs; SP metadata can include an active cert + a rollover cert. We will ship metadata with both certs if you can provide the IdP certs early.

2) SCIM provisioning: Redwood’s SCIM implementation accepts PATCH and PUT. Attribute mapping:
  - userName -> email
  - name.givenName -> firstName
  - name.familyName -> lastName
  - emails[0].value -> email (primary)
  - custom:department -> department
  - custom:role -> role

3) ControlPlane IAM mapping (proposed):
  - ControlPlaneAdmin: create/update models, manage deployments, view audit logs, manage integrations
  - ReadOnlyAuditor: view-only access to jobs, logs, and audit artifacts
  - ConnectorOperator: manage the on-prem connector lifecycle (start/stop, health-check)

Proposed example JSON (for our provisioning API):
{
  "roles": [
    { "name": "ControlPlaneAdmin", "permissions": ["deploy:create", "deploy:update", "audit:view"] },
    { "name": "ReadOnlyAuditor", "permissions": ["audit:view"] },
    { "name": "ConnectorOperator", "permissions": ["connector:manage"] }
  ]
}

4) Offline pre-provisioning: we have a manual CSV upload workflow that our Onboarding team runs; it creates users with temporary passwords and flags them as pending-activation. We can surface that to Acme Ops if needed.

I'll attach the JSON and a short script to translate Acme's columns into our SCIM attributes before our call.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior SWE, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick updates. A few compliance/logging items we need to lock before the pilot: 

- Audit snapshot retention: Acme requested 1 year of immutable audit logs for the pilot. For Private CP on-prem, confirm the retention policy (by default we keep 90 days; can extend to 13 months with archived storage).
- Access review cadence: recommend quarterly access reviews for ControlPlaneAdmin accounts during the pilot period and a monthly review for ConnectorOperator roles.
- Evidence for SOC2 onboarding: we’ll need a packaged set of controls around SCIM provisioning, SAML assertion validation, and connector TLS configuration. Laura — can your team prepare the evidence packet if Acme confirms?

Marcus — can you validate whether our archive storage for audit logs will be write-once for the 13-month plan?

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
